source_title: LIC HFL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 232 Apprentice Posts (12-Month Training)
source_excerpt:
Vacancies: 232 · Posts: 1 designation(s) · Type: Company · Apprenticeship (12 Months) · Mode: Online · Fee: ₹200 + GST (SC/ST/PwBD) / ₹800 + GST (Gen/EWS/OBC Male) / ₹600 + GST (Gen/EWS/OBC Female/Transgender) · Apply: 20 Oct–1 Nov 2026 · Stipend: ₹16,650 (Metro) / ₹14,150 (Other) · Selection: Online Exam + DV & Interview · Location: Multiple cities across India
LIC Housing Finance Limited (LIC HFL) has invited applications from fresh graduates to join the LICHFL Apprenticeship Program-010 as apprentices. This 12-month on-the-job training helps selected candidates build soft skills, domain knowledge, and real-time work experience. Apprenticeship is not employment; apprentices are only trainees, and LIC HFL is not obliged to provide full-time employment after completion.
The programme covers 232 training seats in various offices of LIC HFL across multiple cities in India. Successful apprentices receive a proficiency certificate from the Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT) and can contact the BFSI Sector Skill Council of India for information on placement opportunities in banks, financial services or insurance companies.
Applications open online from 20 October 2026 to 1 November 2026. Candidates must first register on the NATS portal if eligible, then complete the detailed application and pay the fee on the BFSI SSC portal after receiving the invitation email. The entrance examination is scheduled for 7 November 2026.
⚠️ Application Alerts: check these before you submit the form.
You must first register on the NATS portal; only then will you receive the email from BFSI SSC to fill out the detailed form and pay the fee by 1 November 2026.
Failure to register for the online examination after fee payment disqualifies you from further participation.
Details entered for the examination registration must match exactly what you entered on the NATS portal; any alteration may disqualify the candidature.
Candidates with any running, terminated or completed apprenticeship contract with another organisation are not eligible.

Organisation: LIC Housing Finance Limited (LIC HFL)
Recruitment / Exam Name: LICHFL Apprenticeship Program-010
Notification / Advertisement No.: LICHFL Apprenticeship Program-010

What Posts Are Available? – Post-wise Vacancy & Eligibility
All 232 seats are for the single designation of Apprentice. The seats are distributed across many cities in various states; most cities have 1 seat, with higher numbers in a few metros such as Bangalore (13), Chennai (7) and Hyderabad (7). The full state- and city-wise list is given in Table E of the notice.
No category-wise reservation breakup is printed in the advertisement.
Who Is Eligible for LIC HFL Apprentice 2026? – Education, Age & Domicile
Nationality, Domicile & Basic Requirements
Nationality: The notice does not state a nationality condition.
Domicile / local condition: The notice does not state a domicile or residence condition.
Candidates must have completed graduation in any stream from an Indian University or Institute recognised by UGC/AICTE as on 1 October 2026, but not before 1 October 2001. The candidate should not have a running, terminated or completed apprenticeship contract with any other organisation.
Qualification must be held by: 1 October 2026
What Is the Age Limit? (as on 01-Oct-2026)
✅ A 24-year-old candidate born on 1 January 2002 — eligible (as on 01-Oct-2026).
❌ A 26-year-old candidate born on 1 January 2000 — not eligible (one full year over the limit).
Use our Age Eligibility Calculator to check instantly.
Reservation: No category-wise reservation breakup is printed in the advertisement.
PwBD: The notice mentions a reduced fee for Person with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) candidates but does not print suitability or reservation details for specific posts.
The monthly stipend is ₹16,650 in Metro Cities (Ahmedabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune, Surat) and ₹14,150 in other cities. This is a flat consolidated amount for the 12-month apprenticeship period. No separate DA, HRA, PF or pension is mentioned in the notice.
Payment mode: Online mode only to BFSI SSC through the secure payment link provided in the application form. No other mode accepted. Refund: Fee/Intimation charges once paid will NOT be refunded on any account nor held in reserve for any other exam or selection. Application once made will not be allowed to be withdrawn and fee once paid will NOT be refunded under any circumstances.
Candidates should first, mandatorily register themselves, if eligible, on the apprenticeship portal of the Government of India: NATS portal ( https://nats.education.gov.in — Navigate to the “Student Register/Login” section). Note the Enrolment ID issued by the NATS portal for all future correspondence. In case of issues, refer to the Candidate User Manual on the NATS portal.
Open the NATS Portal (open until 1 November 2026).
Register if eligible and apply for the LICHFL apprenticeship advertisement after login.
After successful application on NATS, you will receive an email from BFSI SSC ( info@updates.bfsissc.com ) inviting you to fill the detailed application (choice of districts etc.) and make payment.
Complete the additional information and pay the examination fee at https://beep.bfsissc.com by 1 November 2026.
Details entered for examination registration must match those on the NATS portal.
Applying only on NATS and missing the subsequent email invitation and fee payment on the BFSI SSC portal by 1 November 2026.
Entering mismatched details between NATS and the examination registration form.
Having any prior apprenticeship contract (running, terminated or completed) with another organisation.
Not completing graduation by 1 October 2026 or falling outside the 1 October 2001 to 1 October 2026 window.
Failing to appear for the remote proctored exam from home in isolation using a camera-enabled device and Aadhaar as ID proof.

Online remote proctored entrance examination conducted by BFSI Sector Skill Council of India on 7 November 2026 (from home in absolute privacy using camera-enabled device; Aadhaar as ID proof).

Candidates who accept the offer report to the respective branch tentatively in the 4th week of November for the 12-month apprenticeship training.

The SahisarkariJobs.in Analyst's Take – Is This Apprenticeship for You?
This is a 12-month on-the-job training engagement, not a job. LIC HFL is explicitly not obliged to provide full-time employment afterwards, though successful candidates get a BOAT proficiency certificate and can seek information on BFSI-sector opportunities. The stipend is modest (₹14,150–16,650) and the selection involves a remote proctored online exam plus interview.
Best fit: Fresh graduates (any stream, completed by 1 October 2026 within the printed window) who want structured industry exposure in housing finance/BFSI without expecting automatic absorption, and who can handle a remote exam from home.
Who should skip: Anyone seeking a permanent or regular post, those with any prior apprenticeship history, or candidates outside the strict 20–25 age band as on 1 October 2026. Also Read: NPCIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 80 Seats at Narora Atomic Power Station

What Are the Apprenticeship Terms & Conditions?
Apprenticeship is an On Job Training provided to selected fresh graduates to help them acquire soft skills, domain knowledge, real time work experience and become industry ready.
Apprenticeship is NOT an employment. Apprentices are NOT Employees. Apprentices are ONLY Trainees.
LIC Housing Finance Ltd is NOT obliged to provide full-time employment to its apprentices.
All Apprentices who successfully complete their apprenticeship with LIC HFL will be issued Proficiency Certificate by BOAT and can contact BFSI Sector Skill Council of India for information on placement/employment opportunity in the Banks, Financial Services, Insurance Companies or any other BFSI sector companies according to the available vacancies.
Engagement letters tentatively 3rd week of November; reporting 4th week of November.
Final selected candidates will be issued engagement letters by LIC HFL stating their Apprenticeship Training Branch, Monthly Stipend Payable, Rules / Regulations / Terms & Conditions related to the apprenticeship program of LIC HFL (tentatively 3rd week of November).
Candidates who accept the offer letters will be asked to report to the respective LIC HFL branch for their apprenticeship training program (tentatively 4th week of November).
On successful completion, Proficiency Certificate is issued by BOAT.
✅ Confirmed: 12-month training, stipend as printed, proficiency certificate on completion. ❓ Not specified: Exact branch allotment process beyond the engagement letter, any extension possibility.

What is the last date to apply for LIC HFL Apprentice 2026?
1 November 2026. Applications are invited from 20 October 2026 to 1 November 2026. Fee payment to BFSI SSC is also by 1 November 2026. No extension has been announced as of 21 October 2026.
What is the age limit for LIC HFL Apprentice?
20 to 25 years as on 1 October 2026. No category-wise relaxation is printed. Age is calculated as on 1 October 2026.
Is there an exam for LIC HFL Apprentice, or is it interview-based?
Online entrance examination (remote proctored, 100 marks, 60 minutes) on 7 November 2026, followed by Document Verification and Personal Interview on 15 November 2026 for shortlisted candidates. Negative marking is not mentioned.
What is the stipend for Apprentice posts in this recruitment?
₹16,650 per month in listed Metro Cities and ₹14,150 per month in other cities. It is a flat consolidated stipend for the 12-month period.
Can final-year students apply for this recruitment?
No — the notice requires that graduation should have been completed as on 1 October 2026 (but not before 1 October 2001). Final-year students who have not completed by that date are not eligible.
Is this Apprentice post a permanent government job?
No — a 12-month apprenticeship training engagement. The notice states apprenticeship is NOT an employment, apprentices are NOT employees and are ONLY trainees, and LIC HFL is NOT obliged to provide full-time employment.
Yes — the notice invites applications from fresh graduates from all Indian Universities/Institutes recognised by UGC/AICTE and lists seats across many states. The notice does not state a domicile or residence condition.
Where will selected candidates be posted?
At various LIC HFL offices across the cities listed in Table E of the notice. The specific branch is stated in the engagement letter.
